key_findings: Window confirmed as trailing: the 12:00 UTC file is the maximum over the 24 h ending at its stamp (exact on 568,026 crop cells for 2025-06-15, 2025-06-16 and 2026-10-16); the forward set matches only 300,912 of 450,765 Montana cells.
Archive reproduced by fresh HEAD scan: 1,825 files, 901,938,706 B; 2022-06-09 lacks 12:00 and 12:30 (46 of 48 files); summer median 1,074,164 B, winter 96,156 B, shoulder 460,464.5 B.

Stratified estimates reproduced exactly from the sidecar: 9,245,170 positive cell-days (95% interval 6,736,622 to 11,753,718); 193,667 at or above 1.00 in; 891,578,501 B; peak day 2022-07-09 re-decoded at 133,429 positive cells.

Corrected: 216 polygon-edge cells give 450,981 cells (strict rule 450,765); tight cell span 464 x 1,201 not 466 x 1,203; the 80,955 B gzip figure is the delta-coded column (raw 103,236 B); single-core decode 19.5 min not 20.9.
Refuted as an expected load: 144 scheduled Website starts a day; P0 records about 9.5 observed (4 starts in 57 ten-minute slots, median gap 151.5 min).

12:00 files were last written 12:08:16 to 12:08:20 GMT on five real-time days; 2-hour files about 4 minutes after stamp. Benchland 77.9 mm is the window ending 02:00 UTC on 2025-06-15 (SPC day 06-14); the SPC day 06-15 peak is 35.7 mm.
Addresses: 674,715 records, 493,975 residence-coded, no OWN field; but DBF lon and lat are all 0 and ParcelID is filled for 654,152 (96.95%), a join risk to owner-bearing parcel files.

Limits confirmed on live pages: scheduled workflows in public repositories are disabled after 60 days without activity and can be dropped under load; the 14 GB runner SSD cannot hold the 69.1 GB 2-minute archive; a Free-plan D1 backfill of 9.25 M rows takes about 93 days; artifact quotas are stated for private repositories only.
open_questions: Counsel: do GitHub Actions clauses gh-terms-1 to -3 and the Pages commercial sentence allow publishing a derived per-address history through Actions and Pages? Not decided here.
Owner: drop ParcelID and any parcel join from published shards (W6 says the parcel files carry owner fields; not re-checked here).
Owner: choose the daily job time and a manual fallback, given observed scheduled-run gaps (median 151.5 min).
Parquet, vector tile and columnar sizes are still unmeasured (pyarrow and tippecanoe are not installed).
NSSL meanings of -1, -3, -99 and -999 remain unverified (W1 domain); the NCEP product guide was not read.
Per-cell and per-tile estimates (median 17.0 days; tile rows median 1,842) need per-cell day grids and were not recomputed.

key_findings: Refuted or corrected: SPC annual times are +60 min on all 190 Montana 2025 rows; Murillo and Homeyer is readable via the AMS article page with a browser agent (2,096,493 B); four package licence claims were wrong; the SPC filter rule is in FAQ 6.11.

SPC daily hail files hold no hail below 1.00 in (8,711 rows, all states, 2025); 115 of 307 Montana 2025 IEM rows are absent by design; at 1.00 in or more SPC and IEM agree on 191 of 192.

2025 Montana hail counts: IEM 307, SPC raw 189, SPC filtered 123, Storm Events 190, SPC annual 190; 23 of 123 filtered rows cite Facebook, social media or Twitter.

Whether a company counts as 'an individual' under MCA 2-6-1017(3); counsel question.
SWDI MAXSIZE units (the linked ICD returns 404).
NCEI and SWDI reuse licence beyond the NOAA general disclaimer.
